text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty SD-9823 triggered — policy-engine service reported runtime exception during rules evaluation. Affects smart-routing/fallback. Error rate spike + routing fallback loop detected.
Maya Chen: I’m on it — paging @Leo and @Olivia. Which policy rolled out in the last 10m?
Leo Patel: I grabbed the rollout logs. Canary for `smart-route-v2` hit 3% traffic ~1753216600. Last config change was a rule expression push by Samir 7m ago.
Samir Gupta: that was me, small expression tweak to prefer region eu-west for enterprise customers. I only changed one line: `if user.region == "eu-west" and score > 0 then prefer_region = "eu-west" end` — nothing fancy.
Olivia Park: logs show a panic in the policy evaluator: `panic: invalid expression: runtime error: integer divide by zero` coming from expr#342.
Maya Chen: divide by zero? That expression shouldn't do arithmetic. Can we get the exact rule text?
Leo Patel: pulling rule blob now — paste: ````
# rule 342
if user.region == "eu-west" and (cache_hits / request_count) > 0.1 then prefer_region = "eu-west" end
````
Olivia Park: aha — `request_count` can be zero for cold sessions. That division wasn’t guarded. Evaluator panicked and aborted evaluation stack, which leads to the routing decision returning empty and falling back. The fallback triggers a region fallback which in turn hits policy-engine again causing a loop.
Samir Gupta: ugh my bad, I missed a guard. Immediate mitigation?
Maya Chen: Mitigation plan: 1) disable the new rule in the policy config (hotpatch), 2) scale down canary so traffic uses stable rule set, 3) restart policy-engine instances that showed panic to clear state, 4) assess customer impact.
Jen Romero: I’ll open a quick rollback PR and request an emergency deploy to disable the rule. Link: https://ci.internal/repo/policies/rollout/PR-542
Leo Patel: Temp config change applied to canary group (ID canary-3) to remove rule 342 — propagation shows OK on control plane.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Config change applied to canary-3 at 1753217012 by Jen Romero. No more new panics in canary logs for 30s.
Olivia Park: we still have some policy-engine pods in eu-west stuck in crashloop from the earlier panic. Killed the pods and restarted — they're coming up healthy.
Maya Chen: good. Can we block automatic fallback to cheaper-model variant until policy-engine is healthy? That was one of the customer-impact multipliers.
Samir Gupta: yes - I’ll push a temporary routing policy that disallows model-variant fallback. Pushing now.
incident-bot: :warning: Route-safety override applied at 1753217104 by Samir Gupta. Fallbacks disabled globally for 5m.
Leo Patel: traffic metrics — p95 latency for text-gen rose from 210ms -> 640ms during the loop. About 2.1% of requests saw a fallback to model 'open-lite-v1' which caused some degraded completions reported via support.
Jen Romero: Noting affected customers: acct-881 (analytics dashboard), acct-202 (chatbot). Support notified and initial customer comms drafted.
Maya Chen: Assigning severity: S2 because partial customer impact and ongoing mitigation. Paging on-call for follow-up: @incident-oncall.
Samir Gupta: root cause summary: unguarded division in rule expression allowed 0 denominator -> runtime panic in policy evaluator -> evaluator aborted rule result -> routing defaulted to fallback which retriggered policy evaluation in a loop.
Olivia Park: long-term fix: evaluator should not panic on expression errors. Instead return a safe false/neutral result and log structured error. Filing follow-up issue to add defensive semantics + expression sandboxing.
Leo Patel: created issue INF-1758: "Policy evaluator should handle divide-by-zero and invalid exprs gracefully" and assigned to eng-runtime.
Maya Chen: postmortem checklist: 1) rollback/deploy timeline, 2) how canary gating missed this (tests?), 3) add static analyzer for expressions, 4) add rate-limited alerts for fallback-loop pattern, 5) customer impact notes.
Samir Gupta: test idea: simulate 0 request_count inputs and run rule set under expr-eval to catch this. I’ll add a unit test.
incident-bot: :page_with_curl: Incident S2 created: INC-2026, channel pinned, followups assigned.
Jen Romero: support updated customers with temporary mitigation note and ETA for stable fix. Copy of comms in #support-updates.
Leo Patel: switching traffic back to stable after validation. Canary saw no panics for 6 minutes; initiating gradual ramp at 1753217660.
incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Canary ramp started at 1753217660. No new panics in policy-engine logs in the last 8m.
Maya Chen: handing off to daytime oncall @Leo for post-incident tracking. I’ll write the initial postmortem draft.
Leo Patel: taking it. Will monitor for 2h and update the postmortem. Thanks all. :v:
